thread: Maya Singh: Quick design sync 1: compact capacity row for small viewports + stepper behaviour. Main questions: do we show cost delta inline in compact mode? How to keep min/max accessible when space is tight? Screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/compact-row-v2.png Elliot Rivera: Love the compact row. For cost delta, inline is helpful but could push other controls off-line. Maybe show a chevron that expands a tiny panel with cost + SLO hint. :chevron_right: Priya Nair: Agree. For accessibility, collapsed content must be reachable via keyboard and the expand button needs aria-expanded. Example: button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"compact-details-1\". Dave L.: On steppers: mobile users will expect tap targets >= 44px. Current +/- are 28px. We need to increase size or make touch-friendly zones. Also add long-press to change by 10s? Maya Singh: Good catch on hit area. Proposal: keep visual icons small but increase hit target with padding. For large adjustments, support shift+click on desktop to jump by 5 and long-press on mobile to jump by 10. Thoughts? Elliot Rivera: Mechanic sounds fine but we should communicate it. Maybe a microcopy below the steppers: "shift+click for x5, long-press for x10" only visible on hover/focus. Priya Nair: That microcopy must be in DOM and visible to screen readers even when visually hidden. Use Press shift and click to increase by 5. Dave L.: UX edge: what happens when min > max after a fast change (shift+click)? We currently clamp but don't explain. We should show a small inline guardrail message: "Min cannot exceed Max 1 resetting to Max" or better, animate the max up to match min with an explanation. Which do we prefer? Maya Singh: Prefer to auto-adjust max up with a subtle animated bump and a transient snackbar that explains: "Adjusted max to match new min". Accessibility note: make that snackbar role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" so it's announced. Elliot Rivera: Also consider allowing an undo in the snackbar: "Adjusted max to match new min — Undo". Keyboard focus should move to the snackbar's Undo link when it appears. Priya Nair: If focus is moved, ensure we restore focus to the original control after undo or timeout. Keep focus management predictable. a11y-bot: A11y checklist: steppers must have role=\"spinbutton\" with aria-valuemin/valuemax and accessible name. Ensure focus order stable when compact panel expands. Touch target >= 44px. Provide visible focus outline >= 3px. Dave L.: SLO slider: people confuse percentiles vs target. Let's update label to "Latency target (95th)" and in compact view show shorthand "95th" next to the slider thumb. Also tooltip on focus: "95th percentile latency target 1 lower is better". Maya Singh: For compact mode, instead of a full slider, we could show a mini slider with larger increments and an explicit "Edit" that opens a full modal for precise control. Keeps row tidy. Elliot Rivera: Mini slider OK but ensure the modal preserves keyboard and screen reader context. Use aria-modal and focus trap. Priya Nair: Microcopy suggestion for guardrail tooltip when someone sets a latency target lower than the recommended floor: "This target may increase cost. We recommend >= 50ms for this pool." Keep it concise. a11y-bot: Reminder: any modal must have aria-labelledby and initial focus on the first interactive element. Also, announce when modal opens: role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\". Maya Singh: Action list from this thread: 1) Implement expandable compact details panel (Elliot) with aria-expanded and keyboard access. 2) Enlarge stepper hit targets and add shift+click / long-press behaviour (Dave). 3) Add sr-only microcopy for advanced stepper controls (Priya). 4) Auto-adjust max when min crosses it and show snackbar with Undo (Elliot+Dave). 5) Mini slider + full-edit modal for SLO in compact mode (Maya). 6) Update labels to "Latency target (95th)" and tooltip copy (Priya). 7) Run a11y-bot on final PR (a11y-bot). Elliot Rivera: I'll prototype the expand panel and snackbar. Will include CSS for increased hit area. Dave L.: I'll wire up the stepper keyboard/long-press and the auto-clamp behaviour. Priya Nair: I'll write the microcopy and a11y snippets. Maya Singh: Thanks team 1 aiming to review the prototype Wed morning. Tagging @a11y-bot for automated checks once the PR is opened. :sparkles:
